clauses.clause_label: Viewing and evaluation limitation; consent requirement
clauses.scope_note: Applies to use of this repository. The text describes the repository as provided for viewing and evaluation only, but does not grant an unconditional use right; it expressly withholds permission to use without prior written consent from AI-Shifu.
clauses.condition_explanation: The stated restriction applies when the recipient does not have prior written consent from AI-Shifu.

clauses.clause_label: No permission without prior written consent
clauses.scope_note: Applies to any part of this repository. The text withholds permission for the listed activities absent prior written consent from AI-Shifu; it does not specify what permission, if any, consent would grant.
clauses.condition_explanation: The stated restriction applies when the recipient does not have prior written consent from AI-Shifu.

coverage_notes: The supplied original is a repository notice, not a complete license grant. No broader permissions or terms are inferred.
The text also says all rights are reserved (lines 1–2); that statement does not independently establish permissions for activities not addressed by the operative restriction.
“Publish” is not separately mapped because the allowed activity list has no matching activity; distribution is expressly addressed.
